install.description: Install Jig rules and the agent skill file into a repository.

update.description: Update the vendored rules to a newer version, showing a diff and skipping files you have edited.

init.description: Set up Jig in this project: detect the CSS system, derive or interview for brand values, validate them against the token contract, and write tokens plus jig.config.json.

check.description: Check the repo against the mechanical and hybrid rules the CLI can detect. Reports findings by rule id; the judgment rules remain yours to apply.

explain.description: Explain a rule, or find the rules you cannot name. Given an id, prints the rule's full text, its correction, the version it arrived in and who checks it — including the P-/M- pattern and mode specs, which no rule index contains. Given a word instead, searches every title and body and lists what matches. `--list` prints every id, or one section's.

spec.description: Plan a screen before building it: run the layout method, record the result, and get it confirmed. Writes .jig/specs/<surface>.spec.md. No CLI — the agent does this.

make.description: Build a screen from its confirmed spec, recording any deviation back into it. Refuses to start without one. No CLI — the agent does this.
